quote: I just got a Tesla. And as I was thinking about it, I was like, hey. What if I just charge this off of the sun?
stewart_read: Customer surfaces a strong, self-generated motivator (new EV, wants to charge from solar) unprompted — a top-tier interest reason.
coaching_implication: Rep should reflect this back later as the appointment's hook (e.g., tie the Friday visit explicitly to 'we'll show you exactly what powering the Tesla from solar looks like') rather than filing it as a design note only at 03:13.

quote: I think we use about 4,000 kilowatt hours a month.
stewart_read: Customer voluntarily gives usage data before being asked, indicating genuine engagement and readiness to move fast.
coaching_implication: Rep could have used this early volunteering to accelerate rapport ('you clearly know your numbers — that'll make the design spot on') instead of treating it as a routine data point.

stewart_read: The bill amount ($500-600/month) is captured but acknowledged with a flat filler line, no flip into alignment-against-the-utility.
coaching_implication: Rep should have flipped this into something like 'that's money going straight to Duke every month — let's see what keeping that in your pocket looks like,' anchoring urgency before the appointment.

quote: got a Tesla. So are you planning on charging from home then?
stewart_read: Rep notes the EV for the design team but never connects it to Tesla Powerwall battery backup, a real Ion offering directly relevant to EV owners wanting home charging resilience.
alternative_hypothesis: Powerwall pitch is closer-tier content and appropriately deferred to the specialist visit.
coaching_implication: At minimum, rep could flag to the customer that the specialist will cover battery backup options for EV charging, seeding curiosity rather than leaving it purely as an internal note.

quote: yeah, the roof is awesome for solar.
stewart_read: Generic compliment on the roof instead of tying the large roofline (customer said 6-7000 sq ft) back to system size/output curiosity.
alternative_hypothesis: This is light rapport-building filler, harmless on its own.
coaching_implication: A quick 'with a roof that size we can really maximize what the system produces — you'll want to see the numbers' would have created forward pull.

quote: I suggest just writing down any questions or concerns you can just possibly think of
stewart_read: Button-up covers text-followup and a light expectation-set, but skips the explicit 'is that fair' handshake and no-driving/computer instruction from the schema.
coaching_implication: Add the standard no-driving/sit-down-at-computer line and a verbal handshake to reduce no-show risk on a two-week-out booking.
